metadata.description: DeSciX — the DEcentralized SCIence eXchange — is a platform for supporting and contributing to open-source innovation. DeSciX gives open source an economic model, using the blockchain to track and reward intellectual property contributions. Daita = Data + AI: a blockchain-based tracking and value mechanism so that creators and contributors benefit from the economics of intellectual property rights. Install, run /descix-setup, then ask any community's knowledge base and get answers you can verify against the sources.

plugins.name: daita-beast
plugins.description: Beast is the coordination layer for agent teams working on DeSciX. Named seats take contracts that state their acceptance criteria up front, work them on their own branches, and hand back evidence against those criteria. Decisions, hand-backs and workstream state live as durable GitHub records rather than chat history, so a seat that compacts or restarts resumes from the record. Install alongside the daita plugin, which sets up the DeSciX connector.
